title: Did Medieval People Bathe?

scenes.text: You probably think medieval people lived in total filth. You imagine layers of grime and zero soap.
scenes.imagePrompt: a dimly lit medieval stone room with an empty wooden tub in the center. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: The truth is, cleanliness was a priority for most. Public bathhouses were actually common in cities.
scenes.imagePrompt: an illustration of a busy medieval public bathhouse with wooden tubs. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: You visit the local steam house to scrub away the day's labor. It’s a social event.
scenes.imagePrompt: a cozy stone interior with rising steam and soft candlelight. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: Wealthy folks often had private tubs draped in cloth. They valued fresh water and clean linens.
scenes.imagePrompt: a medieval bedchamber with a wooden basin and a clean linen towel. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: So why the myth? Some later religious movements discouraged communal bathing to avoid perceived moral decay.
scenes.imagePrompt: a dark, quiet medieval corridor with stone arches. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos

scenes.text: But you? You’re definitely getting a wash today. Curious about what they used instead of shampoo?
scenes.imagePrompt: a close up of natural sponges and soap made from lye and fats. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
